plan.title: Whole-blood case vs control classifier + DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: The cohort is 60 cases vs 60 controls, whole blood, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 121 samples incl. metadata). Two related but distinct questions are asked: (1) is there a reproducible transcriptional difference between cases and controls, and (2) can a classifier built on expression predict case/control status on a new sample, with an honest estimate of its accuracy. Because each group has 60 samples (>=50/group), the knowledge base flags that DESeq2/edgeR's negative-binomial assumption is violated in large population cohorts and produces excess false positives even on permuted labels — so the differential expression test uses limma-voom with TMM normalization, not DESeq2's Wald test, with the caution stated in the report. QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) runs first to confirm the samples group by condition and that no sample is a technical outlier before any test. Genes are pre-filtered with filterByExpr, TMM-normalized, and tested with a fixed-effects linear model in limma-voom; the reported log2 fold changes are DESeq2-apeglm-shrunk from a parallel run purely for reporting/ranking stability (limma effect sizes are already moderated by design, so this is a secondary sensitivity check, not the primary test), FDR is BH-controlled at 0.05, and the p-value histogram is inspected before trusting the adjusted p-values. camera (which accounts for inter-gene correlation, appropriate at this sample size) tests the limma fit against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome and WikiPathways, all present in the reference store for human. Separately, the classifier question is answered as its own supervised-learning task: a penalized (elastic-net) logistic regression on the full filtered/normalized gene matrix, with gene filtering, scaling and lambda selection performed strictly inside each fold of a nested cross-validation, reporting ROC-AUC with a confidence interval from the outer-fold predictions and the genes with non-zero coefficients. This is kept as an explicitly separate step from the DE test so that the accuracy estimate is not inflated by prior gene selection on the same samples (the DE gene list is not used as a fixed feature filter for the classifier). Given the analysis is whole blood, an immune-cell composition read-out (immunedeconv / MCPcounter on TPM-scale data) is added because a case-control difference in blood is a common confound/finding driven by cell-type composition shifts (e.g. neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio), and any DE or classifier signal must be interpreted alongside it.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: vst(blind), PCA, sample distances, library sizes
limma-voom with a fixed-effects linear model
apeglm log fold change shrinkage (via DESeq2 sensitivity check, not primary voom path)
camera competitive gene set test on the limma fit, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome/WikiPathways
Penalized logistic classifier with glmnet, nested cross-validation, ROC/AUC with CI
Reproducibility report with session info, diagnostics, effect sizes
